patch.summary: Is Mailchimp worth it? Email marketing platform with CRM-oriented contact and audience tools; freemium entry for smaller lists.. Strong when Marketing teams needing email + audience CRM features. Weak when Marketing-led CRM — not a full sales pipeline platform.

blocks.body: Mailchimp earns a yes only when researched fit beats researched limits — not when the brand is familiar.

sections.heading: Mailchimp ROI gate for evaluators
sections.body:
Evaluator thesis: Worth the seat spend if contact management + lead management are weekly must-haves. Counter-signal: Not worth it if Marketing-led CRM — not a full sales pipeline platform collide with your constraints.

Capability hinge for this product: contact management; lead management; pipeline management; deal management.

Integrations in research: confirm on the product hub.

Paid tiers that usually matter in evaluation: Essentials, Standard, Premium.

sections.heading: Who Mailchimp is worth it for — and who should avoid it
sections.body:
Worth it for: Choose Mailchimp when email marketing + audience CRM features are the primary need..

Avoid if: Compare HubSpot, ActiveCampaign, or Pipedrive if you need stronger sales CRM pipelines..

If avoid signals dominate, start the alternative path with HubSpot on the same job-to-be-done.

sections.heading: Mailchimp price/value and next evaluation step
sections.body:
Prove one real workflow on the documented free/trial path before arguing for Essentials.

Tradeoff to accept consciously: Published packaging clarity vs ecosystem depth.

Next step: run contact management end-to-end, then decide.
